text: Carved pawns shaped like cones and spools slide house to house, painted small on a tomb wall beside the dead. Barbershops smell faintly of weeping, and everyone remembers it. Voltage is pressure, current is flow, resistance is a knot tied by someone cleverer than you. A city called Armada is built entirely from ships lashed hull to hull, its districts drifting slowly across open ocean pulled by chained sea-beasts.
